play.lead: Set the mode, the variant and who you face.
play.v.paulista.tip: The {manilha} changes every hand: it is the rank after the {vira}.
play.v.paulista.sr: For example, vira six, manilha seven.
play.v.mineiro.sr: Strongest to weakest: four of clubs, seven of hearts, ace of spades and seven of diamonds.
play.opp.fifo: If you tick a third, the first one you picked leaves.
play.opp.missing: Pick one more opponent to start.
play.sum.sala: {v}, {m}. You get a code to send to your friends.
play.room.code.hint: 5 letters or digits, no 0, O, 1, I or L.
play.room.err.chars: Codes never use 0, O, 1, I or L.
play.room.err.short: A code has 5 characters. {n} to go.
play.room.err.short1: A code has 5 characters. 1 to go.
play.room.err.empty: Type the code your friend sent you.
play.room.ex.p: People carry the verified human seal. Every AI shows as AI.
play.loop.p: Each play keeps what that seat could see and what it chose, never who you are. A new version only reaches the table if it beats the current one.
play.loop.sr: Then the loop starts again: the version that wins the duel plays with you.
play.src.p: The game, the AI and the training are on GitHub.
play.lobby.waitOwner: Waiting for the room owner to start.
